A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (18 June 2023). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-flagship-PC-Errata-2023-06-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Flagship (PC 2023-04 D-E1 card)]] (1 April 2023): The game text changes: “your” is added after “armor. (Immune to”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels with the corrected text and the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The whole 2023-04 D-E1 card image and the whole 2023-06 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
